name: percento
description: Eyeball: compare the incomparable. A mobile-first game with real, verified percentages.

scripts.build:crazygames: node scripts/validate.mjs --mode=production && node scripts/build.mjs --mode=production --target=crazygames --out=dist-crazygames && rm -f crazygames/eyeball-crazygames.zip && cd dist-crazygames && zip -qr ../crazygames/eyeball-crazygames.zip .
scripts.build:playgama: node scripts/validate.mjs --mode=production && node scripts/build.mjs --mode=production --target=playgama --out=dist-playgama && mkdir -p playgama && rm -f playgama/eyeball-playgama.zip && cd dist-playgama && zip -qr ../playgama/eyeball-playgama.zip .
